Info

Defines DecompileErrorHandler providing structured error reporting and exit codes.

class scaralang.infrastructure.command.decompile.error.decompile_error_handler.DecompileErrorHandler[source]¶

Bases: object

Handles diagnostic formatting and exit code resolution for decompile errors.

It defines:

methods:
format_error - Formats structured diagnostic message from an error.
format_file_missing - Formats missing binary file error message.
resolve_return_code - Resolves CLI return code for an error.
get_version - Returns the error handler version string.
